chapter.title: Create
subtitle: Rotation, and everything it turns.
Bram's half of the valley, from one shaft outward.

hover: The first thing you make here.

images.hover: Cargo and rotation on one strap.
Copper and zinc in a hot basin.
The shell on the clever half.
Only the crafters can build it.
Where a train stops and is named.

quests.title: Craft Eight Andesite Alloy
quests.subtitle: Act I asks for eight of these too.
description: Craft eight &aAndesite Alloy&r from andesite and iron nuggets. Almost every recipe in this chapter opens with it.
Make more than eight. You will be back at this bench.

quests.title: Craft Eight Shafts and Four Cogwheels
quests.subtitle: One carries rotation, one turns it.
description: Craft eight &aShafts&r and four &aCogwheels&r. A shaft carries rotation straight; a cogwheel turns the corner or changes the speed.
Andesite alloy and stripped logs make both.

quests.title: Turn a Hand Crank
quests.subtitle: Power for one job while you stand there.
description: Craft a &aHand Crank&r and set it on a shaft. Hold right-click and it turns whatever the shaft feeds.
It is how Act I grinds its first sixteen flour.

quests.title: Stand a Water Wheel in a Stream
quests.subtitle: Free power. No fuel, no upkeep.
description: Bram: "Two of them. On the race. I have been looking at that gap for sixty years."
Place a &aWater Wheel&r where flowing water hits its blades and run a shaft out of the side. Seasoned boards or the mod's own recipe, either works.

quests.title: Craft Eight Andesite Casing
quests.subtitle: The wooden shell on half of Create.
description: Craft eight &aAndesite Casing&r. It wraps a shaft so rotation can cross a wall, and it is a part in most machines below.
Stripped logs plus andesite alloy.

quests.title: Grind Sixteen Flour on a Millstone
quests.subtitle: One cogwheel underneath is enough.
description: Build a &aMillstone&r and turn it with a cogwheel below. Drop wheat in the top, take flour out of the bottom.
The same stone doubles most raw ore. Act I, step 6 runs on one.

quests.title: Press Eight Iron Sheets
quests.subtitle: Ingots in, plates out, one at a time.
description: Hang a &aMechanical Press&r over a depot and feed it rotation from above. Run eight iron ingots under it.
&bIron sheets&r are in half the recipes left in this chapter.

quests.title: Run a Belt Between Two Shafts
quests.subtitle: Cargo and rotation on one strap.
description: Craft a &aBelt Connector&r, right-click one shaft, then a second shaft up to nineteen blocks off. The belt draws itself between them.
A belt carries rotation as well as boxes.

quests.title: Put Up a Bearing and Eight Sails
quests.subtitle: Wind, where there is no stream.
description: Place a &aWindmill Bearing&r facing out, build eight &aSails&r into a cross on its face, then right-click the bearing.
Bram puts one on the mill roof in Act II, step 10.

quests.title: Build an Encased Fan
quests.subtitle: Through fire, water or lava.
description: Build an &aEncased Fan&r and give it rotation. Air pushed through fire smelts, through water washes, through lava blasts.
Cheapest bulk cooking in the pack, and it has no menu.

quests.title: Build a Mechanical Saw
quests.subtitle: One log, six planks, no hands.
description: Already have one from Bram? Lay it flat and feed it logs off a belt anyway — stood upright it fells the whole tree instead.
Bram's hundred and twenty-eight boards in Act I go faster on one.

quests.title: Set a Mixer Over a Basin
quests.subtitle: One block of air between them.
description: Put a &aBasin&r down, leave one block of air, and set the &aMechanical Mixer&r above it. Rotation comes in at the top.
Anything dropped in the basin combines.

quests.title: Wash Sixteen Crushed Iron
quests.subtitle: Nine nuggets a lump, and redstone.
description: Mill raw iron into &aCrushed Iron&r, drop it on a belt, and blow water through the fan at it.
Nella's lake sand goes under the same fan in Act II, step 12.

tasks.title: Sixteen crushed iron washed under the fan.

quests.title: Light a Blaze Burner Under the Basin
quests.subtitle: Heat turns mixing into alloying. One trip to the Nether.
description: Craft an &aEmpty Blaze Burner&r, take it to a nether fortress and right-click a blaze with it. Set the lit burner under the basin and feed it coal.
No portal yet? There is a ruined one in the pines at &b-728, 232&r — see &6Places&r. Ten obsidian and a flint and steel is the other road.
&cBlazes throw fire.&r Take a shield and a bucket of water.

tasks.title: Burner lit and standing under the basin.

quests.title: Mix Sixteen Brass Ingots
quests.subtitle: One copper, one zinc, one hot basin.
description: Crush copper and zinc on the millstone, drop both into the heated basin, and press what pours out into sixteen &aBrass Ingots&r.
Zinc is a real ore down there. Ask Tobin where.

quests.title: Craft Eight Brass Casing
quests.subtitle: The shell on the clever half.
description: Press brass into sheets, then craft eight &aBrass Casing&r with stripped logs. Tunnels, funnels, crafters and the deployer all wear it.
Same press you built two steps back.

quests.title: Wear the Engineer's Goggles
quests.subtitle: They read a shaft off its own network.
description: Craft &aEngineer's Goggles&r and put them on. Look at any shaft and the &bstress&r and &bspeed&r of that network show on screen.
A stressometer nails the same number to a wall.

quests.title: Set a Deployer on a Depot
quests.subtitle: A hand that holds one tool.
description: Build a &aDeployer&r, point it at a depot and turn it. It uses whatever you put in its hand: a hoe, a bucket, a pair of shears.
Two of them over a belt will plant and cut a field without you.

quests.title: Hang Eight Brass Lamps
quests.subtitle: Four colours, and a redstone switch.
description: Craft eight &aBrass Lamps&r from a nugget, a torch and a plate, and hang them over the workshop.
The forty posts on the road take a different fitting: see the &6Power and Logistics&r chapter.

quests.title: Build Eight Mechanical Crafters
quests.subtitle: A crafting grid a machine can feed.
description: Set eight &aMechanical Crafters&r in the shape of the recipe, wrench each one until the arrows follow one path, then turn the group.
Eight covers every recipe in the pack that needs them.

quests.title: Craft a Precision Mechanism
quests.subtitle: Nothing but the crafters can make it.
description: Feed cogwheels, golden sheets and an iron nugget into the crafter grid and watch it assemble in stages.
It is the part behind stations, arms and every clever block left.

quests.title: Set a Mechanical Arm Over a Belt
quests.subtitle: Six inputs, six outputs, one arm.
description: Craft a &aMechanical Arm&r, right-click its inputs and outputs while holding it, then place it and give it rotation.
One arm does the work of a dozen funnels over a row of machines.

quests.title: Lay Sixteen Lengths of Track
quests.subtitle: Right-click twice; it draws the curve.
description: Assemble sixteen &aTrack&r on the crafters. Place one, right-click a second spot with the same item, and the rail bends between them.
Tobin lays this line to the square in Act III, step 11.

quests.title: Stand a Station on the Line
quests.subtitle: Where a train stops and gets a name.
description: Place a &aTrack Station&r beside your rail and name it. Right-click the track with a &aRailway Casing&r to set a bogey, then add a seat.
Oda's wagon unloads at one of these.

rewards.title: The Line to the Square
rewards.description: Next: Act III runs this track from Tobin's adit into town, and Act I wants two water wheels on the mill race.

quests.title: Give a Train a Schedule
quests.subtitle: Two stations and it runs without you.
description: Write two station names into a &aSchedule&r and hand it to the conductor in the seat. The &aConductor's Whistle&r calls a train back.
A second station anywhere in the valley is all it wants.
